title: Sister cells
body: A divided cell becomes two. They carry the same constructs, and each one keeps her own ATP, her own fuel, and her own integrity. One can be feeding in a plume while the other is starving a short way off.

The species plate switches which body you are. The resource bar follows the cell in hand. Population is the count of living sisters. When the cell you are holding dies, you continue as a living sister. If she was the last, the run ends.
